scope: Independent single-wall 3D origin drag and vertical corner / horizontal finished-floor snapping
schema: existing wallTiling layout.offset/startHeight/reference and optional followFloor

behavior.plane: selected production wall in facing-wall U / absolute Z millimetres
excluded: hidden area above production low-wall cut
behavior.apply: detach only selected wall from floor following and preserve effective size/gap/orientation/reference
behavior.cancel: restore exact UV arrays and temporary clipping materials; retain original link

runs.scope: additional pointercancel, lost capture and blur restoration

browser.testInstrumentationRepair: scene-observation now records the observer instance performing the active update rather than assuming only one observer exists
coverage: real continuous mouse drag before release
vertical corner and horizontal floor-line sliding, intersection priority
frozen camera and temporary foreground cutaway
reset, invalid input, Escape, pointercancel, capture loss and blur
one-face detach and undo restores old link; redo and refresh

limits: only previously enabled production wall surfaces can be previewed
unknown finished floor or wall position must be resolved first
manual origin preview does not render unsaved size/enable changes from the ordinary elevation form
furniture remains opaque; cutaway affects architecture only
no opening reveals, sloping walls, cutting or offcut optimization
